[list]
[*][b]Instant Access:[/b] Press 'G' to open a clean menu, type the name or ID, and get your item immediately.[/*]
[*][b]Smart Search:[/b] Find what you need without memorizing IDs (e.g., "Diamond," "Wood," "Sap").[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer Safe:[/b] Operates strictly locally. Only you receive the item—no game-breaking glitches for your friends![/*]
[*][b]Vanilla UI:[/b] An interface designed to blend seamlessly with the game's original art style.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kkyx6N5.png[/img]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/url]﻿[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod folder in Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Install any content pack you want by unzipping it in Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DYGk9jV.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Load your saved game.[/*]
[*]Press G (default key).[/*]
[*]Enter the name or ID of the item.[/*]
[*]Adjust the amount and press Enter.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/AKJAJGi.png[/img]
